items.label: ✦ Flattering Crew Neck & Cap Sleeve Design
items.value: This timeless maxi dress features a soft crew neck and cap sleeves that cover arms gently, with a flowing curved hem that skims your figure beautifully. Hugs in all the right places without feeling restrictive—ideal for everyday confidence. Cap Sleeve/ Crew Neck/ Maxi Dress/ Curved Hem/ Classic Fit/ Versatile Dress/ Solid Color/ Floral Print.

items.label: ✦ Ultra-Soft All-Day Comfort Fabric
items.value: Crafted from 95% Polyester + 5% Spandex blend, this dress feels silky smooth against skin—lightweight yet not sheer. Breathable for warm days and wrinkle-resistant, perfect for travel or busy schedules (no ironing needed!) .

items.label: ✦ Effortlessly Versatile for Every Occasion
items.value: Dress down with sneakers for grocery runs, layer with a blazer for office meetings, or add a belt and heels for dinner dates. Works for brunch, church, family gatherings, vacation, or casual home days—truly a wardrobe staple .

items.label: ✦ Fits All Body Types Perfectly
items.value: Sizes S(US 4-6), M(US 8-10), L(US 12-14), XL(US 16-18), XXL(US 20-22). True-to-size fit that flatters curves and offers room to move—choose your regular size for a comfortable, polished look .

items.label: ✦ Easy Care & Long-Lasting Quality
items.value: Machine washable (cold water) and tumble dry low—colors stay vibrant wash after wash. No dry cleaning needed, saving you time and money. Available in neutral solids and subtle florals you’ll reach for again and again .
